scope: Actual visual review of16 images; currentv2 Chinese and Japanese native images reopened and hashes confirmed. No code or primary review files edited by reviewer.

findings.native_depth: Source has thick bright gold serif face, close dark contact and lower-right soft shadow. New Chinese 真实/个性 and Japanese 本当の/性格を show close edge and soft shadow at300x250; fine CJK horizontals remain somewhat lighter.
findings.layout_zh: Four lines readable, no visible stretch/crop; upper blocks dense/lower blocks sparse, minor density discontinuity.
findings.layout_ja: Five lines readable and more even; 額縁 slightly dense but readable, second/fifth lines keep side margins.
findings.restoration: No readable Portuguese, complete rectangular seam, repeated column stripes or isolated left-edge bright patch. Repaired grain more uniform/fine. Hidden texture fidelity uncertain and must be described as approximation.
findings.scene: Portrait, frame and street visually continuous; zero changed pixels requires separate program evidence.
findings.comparison: Substantive depth improvement versus historical flat first draft. Style very close to previously improved draft; no evidence of another dramatic type-style leap. Background more continuous than prior column repair.

minor_suggestions_not_applied: If further optimizing Chinese, test only3–4 native pixels more spacing in lower two lines; no glyph stretching and do not also increase shadow.
If further optimizing Japanese, test only0.3–0.5 native pixel first-line tracking; do not widen beyond second/fifth line.
